mesh.corner_tet_mean_ratio_definition: 12*(3V)^(2/3)/sum(six squared edge lengths); regular tetrahedron=1, degenerate=0. Corner geometry diagnostic only.
mesh.quadratic_jacobian_check: Four C3D10 integration points and centroid; all positive. This is not a formal interval proof at every point.

case.name: LC4_back_press_5N
case.distribution: Uniform vector surface traction, integrated using 7-point quadratic-triangle shape functions; total resultant normalized to specified N.

mesh.corner_tet_mean_ratio_definition: 12*(3V)^(2/3)/sum(six squared edge lengths); regular tetrahedron=1, degenerate=0. Corner geometry diagnostic only.

cases.p95_definition: 95th percentile of integration-point von Mises stress weighted by actual C3D10 Jacobian quadrature volume; avoids overweighting locally tiny elements.
cases.auxiliary_stress_scope: Diagnostic only: removes element-centroid regions within 3 mm of the minimum horizontal point anchors, which can create stress singularities. The global maximum remains separately reported and is not replaced for a strength claim.
cases.interpretation: Bilateral Z supports model a supported/held test fixture. Negative net foot reaction indicates lift-off for a free unbonded mouse; that case is not a valid all-five-feet contact prediction. Peak stresses near constraints/load edges may be singular; p95 is a convergence diagnostic, not a strength substitute.
cases.observation: Work-conjugate surface displacement sum(F_i dot u_i)/sum(load magnitudes)

support.assumption: Five bilateral Z-only pad supports; minimum three in-plane rigid-body restraints. Negative normal reactions invalidate a free, unbonded, all-feet-down contact interpretation.
